Stages 'seed, series_a' come from one principal's stated focus on the site; check size not stated on fetched pages (a search summary said $1M-$8M, unverified; a job post said seed-Series B).
Fund close date is the Fortune article date (2025-06-25). A 2024 Yamaha release cited Fund III at $125M (pre-final close).
Arintra HQ not stated by Pulse 2.0 (funds to open a Bay Area HQ); hq_country US assumed from a search-result press-release dateline, unverified on a fetched page.
